title: Pixlar O Ljud Live #2
intro: A real-time audiovisual performance in four chapters, moving from sunset into the depth of night.

content: A real-time audiovisual performance developed in {link:https://derivative.ca/}TouchDesigner{/link}, in which generative visuals respond to live music. Performed together with musician Melisa Hümmet, the work unfolds across four songs. Audio-reactive behaviors let color, light, and form move with the beat, while live adjustments to the system keep the performance open to improvisation. Each scene stands on its own, yet together they form a journey through fading light and deepening night.

Performed at {link:https://www.musikcentrumsyd.se/nyheter/malm-music-innovation-day}Pixlar Och Ljud Live{/link} as part of Malmö Music Innovation Day, {link:https://hypnostheatre.com/}Hypnos Theater{/link}, September 2026.
